tactics:
have key : ∀ (l : List α) (t : List.Mem a l), List.Mem.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive l t := by
  intro l t
  induction t with
  | head as => exact ⟨by constructor, F _ _ (by constructor)⟩
  | tail b h ih => exact ⟨by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2, F _ _ (by constructor <;> first | exact ih.1 | exact ih.2)⟩
exact F _ t (by induction t <;> constructor <;> assumption)
